title: Identifiable Models & Updates by ID
hints: Find the element's index by id, then mutate through the subscript.
Switch on `(command, index)` — `let i?` matches only when the item exists, `nil` when it doesn't.
jsBridge: `Identifiable` gives models a stable `id`, the Swift equivalent of React's `key` prop. SwiftUI's `ForEach` and `List` use it to diff rows. Updating by ID with `firstIndex(where:)` is the standard mutation pattern.

compass.q: React's `key` prop and SwiftUI's `Identifiable`: what goes wrong in each when IDs are unstable (array index as key)?
`Identifiable` vs `Hashable` vs `Equatable`: what does each do for SwiftUI?
Two items with the same `id` in a `ForEach`: what happens? (Undefined, logs a warning.)
IDs: `UUID()` generated client-side vs server IDs. What breaks when you create an item offline?
